description: Add an extra phone number or email address to a contact (kind phone|email, value, optional label such as work, home or mobile). The primary phone and email stay update_person's. A value the contact already has (extra or primary) is not added twice. An extra email also links that address's Gmail messages to this contact, as in Dayze. undo_contact_change(change_id) removes it. ($0.05; API key required)

kind.description: Whether this extra contact method is a phone or an email, e.g. phone.

label.description: Phone label, e.g. work, home, mobile (phones only).

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

value.description: The phone number (digits, e.g. +65 9123 4567) or email address.
